items.q: Is the commission taken from the whole channel?
items.a: No. The platform's 30% applies only to videos created inside the ecosystem and published through it. Other videos are not counted.

items.q: Can I choose the content language?
items.a: Settings offer a catalogue of 30 language options. Voice generation depends on the connected provider.
No. Content passes moderation before publishing, and material that needs changes is sent back for rework.

items.q: How many interface languages are there?
items.a: Thirty. The interface and the content settings both use that list.

items.q: Is the subscription part of the revenue share?
items.a: No. The subscription is billed separately from the revenue share.
No. Earnings depend on how the videos perform and on YouTube's own rules, so no amount is guaranteed.

items.q: How do I connect a YouTube channel?
items.a: You authorise the connection from your profile. The ecosystem only gets the access you grant.
Yes. You can withdraw the permission at any point, and publishing stops.

items.q: Can I see a video before it goes out?
items.a: Yes. Every video goes through an approval step where you can accept it, request changes or reject it.
Yes. Both regular videos and Shorts are handled in the same workspace.

items.q: Can I export or delete my data?
items.a: Yes. You can request an export of your data or its deletion from your account settings.
